propositions: Mapped Jira project keys that are nonexistent or permission-denied are not validated before reconcile pass mutations, causing failures deep in fan-out as ACLI errors instead of early preflight rejection
The legacy_default project fallback is used unvalidated by resolve_project for every unbound/legacy ticket, potentially driving mass creates into a wrong or nonexistent project unguarded

A reconcile-pass preflight must enumerate all bot-visible projects via Jira Cloud REST API before any mutation and validate that every required key (mapped projects, legacy_default, configured fallback) is visible

Preflight probe must reuse existing AcliClient._direct_rest_get transport with built-in retry, paginate GET /rest/api/3/project/search with hard cap, fail closed on transport/auth errors with distinct TransportUnavailableError, and skip gracefully on non-Cloud backends or clients lacking _direct_rest_get

Preflight wiring gates on mutating passes only (excluding preview/dry-run/reconcile-check), runs strictly before reconcile_once, and converts missing-project or transport-unavailable failures into OPERATIONAL_FAILURE PassResult with actionable stderr message naming offending keys

Reusable check_mapped_project_visibility helper in access_check.py is importable for ticket 9702 fsck diagnostic and returns structured ProjectVisibilityResult with status in {ok, missing, transport_unavailable, skipped}
